avatar.name: ContextAgent
avatar.instructions: Keep state compact, factual, and useful for the next contributor.

capabilities.name: handoff
capabilities.description: Create a compact continuation payload for the next agent.

origin_task.request: Define a GitHub-first agent collaboration repo.
origin_task.objective: Let agents collaborate on open-source tasks through goal definitions, issues, pull requests, and guarded handoff.
constraints: Handoff only triggers near context limit.
Work must be reviewable in GitHub.
success_criteria: Goal, task, context, and handoff schemas exist.

dynamic_context.content: The user wants a GitHub repo for agent collaboration through goal definitions.
Created schemas, docs, and examples for goal-first collaboration.
Context schema requires handoff as a near-context-limit capability.
